entities.summary: Auguste Bérard was a French surgeon. He was the brother of physician Pierre Honoré Bérard (1797–1858). He is not to be confused with the French naval officer of the same name (1796–1852), after whom the Berardius beaked whales are named.

entities.summary: Auguste Bérard was a French surgeon. He was the brother of physician Pierre Honoré Bérard (1797–1858). He is not to be confused with the French naval officer of the same name (1796–1852), after whom the Berardius beaked whales are named.
